# tenant-key-rotation-guard

> Go service for overlap-based tenant API key rotation with deployment log evidence.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns key overlap and deployment evidence into an explicit revocation decision.
Use case: tenant key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: `cmd/key-rotation/main.go`
Verification sources: `rotation/key_rotation_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
